Prophet_With_US_Holidays.type: Pure Time Series (Seasonality + US Country Holidays)
Prophet_With_US_Holidays.note: Best pure forecasting model. Captures national sales spikes and holiday dips.

key_takeaways: Prophet operates as a true forward-looking forecaster (no daily actual lag dependencies).
Adding US country holidays reduced Prophet RMSE from 18.529 to 18.473 and WAPE to 24.42%.
Prophet forecasts serve the 30-day forward demand directly into the inventory restock pipeline.
